data.name: BooleanProperty
data.value: {0} is a boolean property, so it matches only true or false, not {1}.
data.comment: {0} is a property name, {1} the value typed. true and false are literal values.

data.name: ComparesNumbersAndDates
data.value: Weaviate compares only numbers and dates with {0}, and {1} is neither.
data.comment: {0} is a comparison operator such as > or BETWEEN, {1} a property name.

data.name: DateProperty
data.value: {0} is a date property, and {1} is not an RFC 3339 timestamp such as 2024-01-31T00:00:00Z.
data.comment: {0} is a property name, {1} the value typed.

data.name: InNeedsValue
data.value: IN on {0} needs at least one value.
data.comment: {0} is a property name. IN is a filter operator.

data.name: MatchesTextOnly
data.value: Weaviate matches text with {0}, and {1} is not a text property.
data.comment: {0} is a filter operator name, {1} a property name.

data.name: NotValidName
data.value: {0} is not a valid Weaviate name.
data.comment: {0} is a class or property name.

data.name: NumericProperty
data.value: {0} is a numeric property, and {1} is not a number.
data.comment: {0} is a property name, {1} the value typed.

data.name: ObjectIdUnknown
data.value: The object's id is unknown, so it cannot be addressed.

data.name: RawFilterShape
data.value: A raw Weaviate filter is a where object, such as { path: ["title"] operator: Like valueText: "*a*" }.
data.comment: The part in braces is Weaviate syntax and stays as it is.
